description: This file defines an abstract class 'AnySoftKeyboardHardware' that extends 'AnySoftKeyboardPressEffects'. It manages hardware keyboard interactions, including key events, physical keyboard switching, and related preferences for the AnySoftKeyboard Android input method. It handles key presses, releases, and special key translations, and manages internal state related to hardware keyboard usage.

classes.name: AnySoftKeyboardHardware
classes.description: An abstract class managing hardware keyboard interactions for the AnySoftKeyboard input method, including key event handling, physical keyboard switching, and user preferences related to hardware keyboard usage.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes preferences related to hardware keyboard behavior and sets internal flags accordingly.

methods.name: onStartInput
methods.description: Resets meta key state when input starts unless restarting.

methods.name: onFinishInput
methods.description: Resets internal state when input finishes.

methods.name: onShowInputRequested
methods.description: Determines whether to show the input view, considering physical keyboard usage.

methods.name: onKeyDown
methods.description: Handles key down events, including special keys, physical keyboard translation, and key repeats.

methods.name: handleBackWord
methods.description: Abstract method to handle backword (word deletion) with physical keyboard.

methods.name: onKeyUp
methods.description: Handles key up events, including meta key state updates and shift/directional keys.

methods.name: setInputConnectionMetaStateAsCurrentMetaKeyKeyListenerState
methods.description: Synchronizes the input connection meta key states with internal meta state.

methods.name: switchToNextPhysicalKeyboard
methods.description: Switches to the next physical keyboard input mode.

methods.name: onPhysicalKeyboardKeyPressed
methods.description: Handles logic when a physical keyboard key is pressed, including hiding the soft keyboard if configured.
